native_acquisition_exception.source: TNM API lists two current native LAZ tiles; usgs-lpc-products.json preserves exact URLs
native_acquisition_exception.blocker: Full native-tile transfer did not complete after more than 6 minutes; a bounded header request returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. Stopped pending transfer and made no further requests to that host.
native_acquisition_exception.fallback_completed: All-depth EPT extract: 283 LAZ octree nodes and 8,111,630 AOI points. Native vertical-CRS confirmation remains unavailable.

coverage_note: AOI bounds describe the crop filter. Each raw EPT node may extend beyond it; exact node keys/bounds are in reports/lidar-selection.json. County complete intersecting features are not clipped.
